title: Orcs vs Uruks: What's the Difference?
script: Orcs and Uruks are just two names for the same evil army. They aren't. Standard Orcs collapse under direct sunlight because their eyes burn. Uruks march through full daylight without losing a single drop of strength. Saruman bred them specifically to erase the one flaw in Sauron's original design. Orcs are fodder for the night. Uruks were built to conquer the sun. Follow for more.
payoff: Uruks were built to conquer the sun.
